ideas.children_he: מְלָכִים וְעַמִּים מְתַכְנְנִים לִמְרֹד בַּה׳ וּבַמֶּלֶךְ שֶׁבָּחַר.
ideas.children_en: Kings and nations plan to rebel against God and His chosen king.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ אֵינוֹ נִבְהָל מֵהַמּוֹרְדִים וּמוֹדִיעַ שֶׁהוּא מִנָּה אֶת מַלְכּוֹ בְּצִיּוֹן.
ideas.children_en: God is not frightened by the rebels and declares that He has appointed His king in Zion.

ideas.children_he: הַמֶּלֶךְ מְסַפֵּר שֶׁה׳ קֵרֵב אוֹתוֹ כְּבֵן וְהִבְטִיחַ לְחַזֵּק אֶת מַלְכוּתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The king says God has welcomed him like a son and promised to strengthen his kingdom.

ideas.children_he: הַמְּלָכִים נִקְרָאִים לְהַקְשִׁיב, לְכַבֵּד אֶת ה׳ וְאֶת מַלְכּוֹ וְלִבְטֹחַ בּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The kings are called to listen, honor God and His king, and trust in Him.
